name: Post a Slack message whenever Nadia publishes

parameters.content:
## Tell your team in Slack every time a post goes live

Nadia publishes on a schedule, which means posts go out while nobody is watching. This workflow turns each publication into one Slack message with the channel, the text and a link, so the team sees what the account said without opening the app.

It uses the **Nadia Trigger**, which registers its own webhook when you activate the workflow and removes it when you deactivate it. There is nothing to configure inside Nadia.

### How it works

1. **Nadia Trigger** receives a signed `post.published` delivery.
2. **Set** flattens the envelope into the few fields the message needs.
3. **Slack** posts to the channel of your choice.

### Setup

1. Add your **Nadia** credential: API key from Settings -> Developers, host `https://app.usenadia.com/api`.
2. Activate the workflow — the trigger registers the webhook at that moment. n8n must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS.
3. Add your **Slack** credential and pick a channel.

### Customize

Add channels to the trigger to watch only some accounts, or tick `automation.triggered` as well to also hear about comment automations that fired.

## The webhook registers itself
Activate the workflow and Nadia starts delivering. Deactivate it and the webhook is removed.

## One readable message
The envelope is flattened before it reaches Slack.
